Definition: Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Zoar is the little city east of the Jordan where Lot fled when Sodom was destroyed. In Genesis 13:10, as thou comest unto Zoar. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zoar reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
